scope: Pagewise stack probes before large Zig/C/C++ frame allocation or alignment, using the shared SDK and native library owners. Existing reserves, initial commits, ABI and kernel stack sizes remain unchanged.

compiler_contract.zig: Compile the original module root to optimized LLVM IR. R4XBuilder streams it and replaces only the known probe-stack=__zig_probe_stack function attribute with inline-asm. The same installed Zig/Clang lowers the IR with LLVM optimization passes disabled. The final module links the object and original native companions using the existing entry and linker contract.
compiler_contract.reason: Enabling Zig stack_check alone emits an out-of-line probe after an align(8192) RSP adjustment, leaving a possible gap across a 4096-byte guard. Inline probes cover both alignment and allocation in the generated prologue.
compiler_contract.c_cpp: The freestanding compiler driver ignores -fstack-clash-protection. Passing -Xclang -fstack-clash-protection to the existing frontend produces pagewise inline probes, including over-page alignment. Shared native C/C++ profiles use the same option.
compiler_contract.rust: Normal Rust kernel and native library target already emit inline probes; their probe configuration is unchanged.
compiler_contract.probe_behavior: Touch each crossed 4096-byte page before local data use. Preserve target ABI, registers, SIMD state and requested alignment; no probe allocation or waiting. Fault handling retains its existing exact execution and resident-headroom rules.
compiler_contract.limits: Probes do not make fixed task stacks larger or allow pageable faults under forbidden owners. Controlled R4X stack exhaustion is the separate 0.84.4 step. Separate Recovery and reference-only NVIDIA RM tools are outside this normal runtime rollout.

validation.static: The actual Spectra and CSTARTD large-frame functions have separate pagewise alignment/allocation probe loops. The IR transformation preserves every other byte and rejects unknown probe contracts.
validation.artifact_snapshot_correction: The first private image captured Spectra before its inline rebuild completed. That Zig result is excluded; the C artifact already matched and passed. After build completion, only CHECK STACK was repeated with an explicit final Spectra hash. This corrected run is the Zig acceptance above.
